name: animx
description: Create AI images and videos from a text prompt, then check status and download the finished media.

interface.longDescription: Animx creates images and videos from a text prompt. Describe the scene you want and Animx generates it: text-to-image, text-to-video, and turning a still image into a short video. You can also check the status of a generation while it renders, and open or download the finished image or video. Animx is for people who have an Animx account: sign in through ChatGPT, and the plugin only reads and creates the generations that belong to that account.
defaultPrompt: Create an image of a cozy neon-lit ramen shop on a rainy Tokyo night
Generate a 5-second video of a fox running through a snowy forest at sunset
Check the status of my latest generation and share the download link when it is done

positive.description: Text-to-image generation returns a media URL and renders the image
positive.prompt: Create an image of a cozy neon-lit ramen shop on a rainy Tokyo night
positive.expected_behavior: generate_image is called once. The response returns a generationId with a queued status, and the Animx media card renders the finished image inline in the conversation together with its direct URL. Credits are deducted from the signed-in account.

positive.prompt: Generate a 5-second video of a fox running through a snowy forest at sunset
positive.expected_behavior: generate_video is called once and returns a generationId with a queued status. The reply explains that the video is still rendering (30-90 seconds, longer for long clips) and that get_generation returns the video URL when it is done.

positive.description: Image-to-video animates an image attached in the chat
positive.prompt: Animate this photo into a short video
positive.expected_behavior: An image is attached to the message. generate_video is called once with the attachment passed as a reference image and returns a queued async result with a generationId.

positive.description: Status check on the most recent generation
positive.prompt: Check the status of my generation
positive.expected_behavior: get_generation is called without a generationId and reports the signed-in account's most recent generation: its status, and the media URL once the status is done.

positive.description: Retrieve the download link for finished media
positive.prompt: Give me the download link for my completed image from earlier
positive.expected_behavior: get_generation returns a finished status and a working public media URL on assets.animx.ai that opens or downloads the image.

negative.description: General knowledge question - no media is requested, so no tool should run
Informational photography question with no generation intent
negative.prompt: How do I take better sunset photos with my phone?

negative.description: Text writing request that only sounds creative-adjacent
negative.prompt: Write a short story about a fox in a snowy forest

review.commerce_description: Animx does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0: generated images and videos now render inline in ChatGPT through an Animx media card; the status check accepts no id and reports the most recent generation; results return deterministic media URLs and no internal job identifiers.
